dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 13, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
Cardinals Top Twins 9-6 in Slugfest

St. Louis' Iván Herrera led the charge with a pair of home runs and three RBIs, while Jordan Walker and Blaze Jordan also homered for the Cardinals in a 9-6 win over Minnesota. Herrera's 2-for-3 performance at the plate was the top batting line of the game, and the Cardinals' staff effort in pitching earned them the win.

Meanwhile, in Toronto, New York Yankees' Cam Schlittler pitched a strong 7.0 innings, allowing just 1 run on 6 hits with 7 strikeouts, as the Yankees took down the Blue Jays 3-1. Paul Goldschmidt's home run (9) gave the Yankees an early lead.

In other action, Los Angeles Dodgers' Yoshinobu Yamamoto tossed 8.1 scoreless innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 hit, as the Dodgers beat the Chicago White Sox 7-1. Max Muncy went 3-for-3 with two home runs and four RBIs for the Dodgers.

In a high-scoring game, Philadelphia Phillies' Jackson Chourio went 4-for-5 with two home runs and four RBIs, but it wasn't enough as the Phillies ultimately fell short in a 9-8 loss to the Milwaukee Brewers.
